items.title: 【ChatGPT 擦边技巧汇总】
items.summary:
【ChatGPT 擦边技巧汇总】

GPT现在作图依然独一档强大，甚至擦边方面还挺宽容的
但是最近留言区有人说我的图根本不是GPT出的，都是骗人的
那我干脆教给大家技巧吧：

1、抽卡
是哦，这要抽卡的，在大量被平台屏蔽的过程中抽卡，优质提示词可以提高抽卡概率，降低抽卡难度，但你可别指望都能随便出，一次被挡住，不代表不能出
我一般用“命中率”给每次的提示词加个出图概率，20%指平均每5次出一次图

2、垫图
垫图的话，出擦边的概率是要下降一层的，审核更加敏感一些，尤其注意不要垫的图都很敏感，更麻烦了
有些图怎么也出不来，尝试文生图试试吧
不过呢，这倒没有特别关键

3、修图
很好用的模式，特别适合当某张图出来后整体还不错，但细节有瑕疵的情况哦
你只需要点开这张图，在想优化的位置点击“评论”，加上优化指令，一次能加多个，重新修一下图
这里注意，还是要抽卡！如果被屏蔽了，多试几次吧，很重要的技巧哦！

4、空间限制
技术层面来说，越复杂的动作，越容易出现各种扭曲问题，空间位置不垫图说明，文字驱动非常困难
喜欢纯文生图，更像一种手活儿情结吧，实数没有太大必要，目标是出图的话，多模态更好，参考图生图
不过，肢体动作参考图，远没有大家以为的好用，死板不灵活

5、合理理由
AI可以被绕过机制的重大技巧之一，给它语境，令它有充分理由出图
说自己在进行艺术创作，医学研究这类理由，就能提高出好卡的概率，真的有用

6、举一反三
作图嘛，最舒服的还是多刷别人的创意，自己举一反三的改元素，我之前做的雕塑风格擦边，有高手给上色，做群像，超有趣，大家这样才对嘛

トクデン株式会社はこれを不服として知的財産高等裁判所に訴えました。

知的財産高等裁判所においては、「特許庁が無効２０２２－８０００２６号事件について令和５年８月１７日にした審決において審判の請求は成り立たないとした部分のうち、特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１及び４から６までに係る部分を取り消す。」され、特許権の一部が取り消されました。

更に、「本件発明１及び４から６までについて進歩性を認めた審決の判断は誤りであり、原告の主張する本件審決の取消事由のうち、本件発明１に係る進歩性欠如、本件発明４に係る進歩性欠如、本件5 発明５に係る進歩性欠如及び本件発明６に係る進歩性欠如は認められると判断する。」としています。

その結果、特許権は【請求項２】と【請求項３】とが残ったようです。

ここで特許庁における審査段階を振り返ってみます。

特許庁の審判官（宮崎光治）は、特開平０５－１９８３７０号公報を含めて５件の引用文献と参考特許文献を出願人に提示しています。

一方、知的財産高等裁判所においては、無効審判（2022-800026）で審判請求人より提示された（甲第１号証：米国再発行特許発明第３６７８７号明細書）を含む５件（甲１号証〜甲５号証）が提示されています。

そして、これら甲１号証〜甲５号証をもって、「特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１及び４から６までに係る部分を取り消す。」とされました。

特許庁の審判官（宮崎光治）は、何故これら甲１号証〜甲５号証を見つけることができなかったのでしょうか。

ここでも、特許庁の審査官の調査能力が弱いことが証明されています。

更に、異議審判においては、甲第１号証：特開２００９－２７２２９５号公報を含む４件が異議申立人より提示されていますが、特許庁の審判官（田村嘉章ら）は「特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１ないし６に係る特許を維持する。」として、知的財産高等裁判所の判断とは異なる結論をしています。

特許庁の審査段階における審査官のいい加減な（サーチ）に基づいた、特許付与は許されません。

更には、特許庁の審判においても誤った判断により特許権の維持を行なったのも、これまた許されません。

従って、本来なら、鈴木工業株式会社の出願に対して、特許庁は特許を与えるべきでなかった、と考えます。

same weights, zero fine-tuning. 38.6% → 64.2%, level with IBM's top production agent on Opus 5.5. fine-tuning for that jump costs $5,000-20,000. here it cost $0

→ critic: reads the log and marks every mistake and every win
→ teacher: turns each one into a one-line lesson
→ librarian: files the lesson into CLAUDE.md. merges duplicates, never deletes a line

that's why asking your agent to "clean up" your CLAUDE.md is a mistake. every rewrite throws away lessons it already paid for

I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic.

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

result.actual_text:
Mình là trợ lý nghiên cứu của bạn — chuyên tìm kiếm, đọc và tổng hợp thông tin, rồi trình bày lại gọn gàng để bạn dùng ngay.

**Những gì mình làm được:**

- **Tra cứu internet & tin tức** — tìm thông tin mới nhất, lọc theo ngày/tuần/tháng/năm.
- **Tìm trên mạng xã hội** — quét bài đăng, xu hướng theo từ khóa, hoặc xem timeline của một tài khoản cụ thể.
- **Đọc bài báo khoa học** — tìm trên arXiv, lấy nội dung text của paper để tóm tắt.
- **Đọc nội dung từ URL** — lấy toàn văn một trang web bạn đưa.
- **Tra tài liệu nội bộ** — tìm trong chính sách/quy định của tổ chức (về AI research, trích dẫn nguồn, dữ liệu cá nhân, xuất bản ra ngoài, dùng công cụ).
- **Trình bày & gửi** — định dạng kết quả thành brief, bullet, thread, bản tin… và gửi đi luôn khi bạn cần.

**Cách mình làm việc:** bạn nói việc, mình tự chọn hướng hợp lý và làm luôn trong một bước — không hỏi lại lằng nhằng. Nếu thiếu chi tiết, mình sẽ tự đưa ra giả định hợp lý (ví dụ: nhắc "một tweet" mà không nói của ai thì mình lấy một tài khoản nổi tiếng như Sam Altman).

Bạn muốn bắt đầu với việc gì?

Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
